binding_constraint: Two core requirement lines the journey cannot fully answer: modern web front ends (React is absent and his single-page-app work dates from 2013-15) and named DevOps tooling (Kubernetes is open; Infrastructure as Code, GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps are not in the journey).

scores.criterion: Hands-on enterprise applications, APIs and services in Python and/or Java
Distributed systems, microservices and cloud-native architecture
Modern web front ends (React or similar)
DevOps: CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code
Data: relational, NoSQL, enterprise data platforms
Technical leadership: reviews, standards, mentoring, stakeholders
Generative AI in production: LLM services, RAG, knowledge retrieval
Vector databases, embeddings and semantic search
AI orchestration frameworks and agent workflows
Prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, AI observability
Responsible AI, security and data governance
